title: Component action of the counter bank
statement: Let $l\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $x$, and choose a single-tape counter configuration $c_i$ for each $i<l$. At coordinate $i$, the bank component action computed from the product configuration agrees with the stationary halting action if $c_i$ is halted, and otherwise agrees with the counter machine's transition on the state and scanned work-tape symbol of $c_i$, using its scanned input symbol as well.
replaced: For every input position, every family of component configurations, and every coordinate $i$, the bank's component action at $i$ computed from the product configuration equals the one-tape counter transition of component $i$ on its own scanned symbol, or the stationary action when component $i$ has stopped.
